name: dsh-custom-models
description: Your own API sites for DeepSeek Harness — relays, gateways, self-hosted and local servers speaking OpenAI Chat Completions or Responses, or Anthropic Messages, requested the way DSH's own custom gateway requests them (the same pi-ai release, bundled) — with many keys per site switched by hand, "fetch models" that reads what each site and model is (new-api / one-api, Charm Hyper, Vercel and OpenRouter balances and prices; a reference of 769 models for the rest), switch groups (one picker entry served by the site you choose), reasoning effort, tool calling and reasoning replay.
